'''[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Koroma Moro''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who hauled cargo under the employ of [[Switch]]. Switch funded Moro's entry into the [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], in an effort to grab a share of the winnings.
